name: Laccy
description:
Clipboard history inspired by Maccy. Laccy is an independent project, not affiliated with Maccy.

This extension reads the clipboard: it records what you copy (text, images and files) in a local history that never leaves your computer, and puts items you pick back on the clipboard. Copies that password managers mark as secret are never recorded.

Requires the Laccy app, which stores the history and shows the popup: https://github.com/mlkonrad/laccy#build-and-install

Click the clipboard icon in the top bar to open your history, or set a shortcut in Preferences.
